author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
You DON'T want to be a 10x engineer.  In fact, any decent engineer can be a 10x engineer if you stuck at the same place long enough and yet you still work very hard.

You won't get pay 10x even you are a 10x engineer, you get 2-3x pay at the max.   That's why you should aim for being a 2-3x engineer and keep expanding your horizon.
